features.name: Item charges for sustainability tracking
features.description: Enable item charge assignment in purchase invoices to track emissions from transport and other upstream activities as part of scope three carbon footprint tracking. Item charges can be assigned by amount, weight, volume, or equally distributed.
caveats: Only works as carbon footprint (CO2 equivalent)
Other gas emissions are automatically calculated to carbon equivalent
Requires enabling item charge and item tracking in emissions in sustainability setup

features.name: Value chain automation for scope three
features.description: Extends scope three carbon footprint tracking across multiple processes including purchase invoices, transfer orders, assembly orders, production orders, and projects. Enables end-to-end emission tracking with flexible attribution models.
caveats: Previously could not assign transport costs with item charges

features.name: Sustainability ledger and value entries
features.description: Foundation feature that produces sustainability ledger entries from sustainability journal, general journal, and purchase invoices. Used for emission reporting across all three scopes and for impact tracking for compliance reasons.
